A '''shadowsuit''' was a suit of body-stocking [[Armor/Legends|armor]] made of [[Shadowsilk/Legends|shadowsilk]], a special light-absorbing material. The shadowsuit was designed to maximize the covert movements of the wearer. As such, shadowsuits did not use electronics that could be detected by [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], except for the optional goggles for the wearer's [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]&mdash;the only part of the body that the suit did not cover. Cushioned [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] and slippers reduced the noise the wearer made by moving.

[[Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles/Legends|Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles]] produced a retail model of the shadowsuit. While not widely available, a number of [[Scoundrel/Legends|thieves]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] used it. Later, the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForces]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] custom-made a number of shadowsuits for their elite covert operatives.

==Description==
The shadowsuit looked like an unpretentious,<ref name="CW">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> pitch-[[Color/Legends|black]] body stocking<ref name="AE" /> that covered the whole body of its wearer<ref name="RO" /> except for the [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Users commonly employed goggles in conjunction with the suit to provide eye protection;<ref name="AE" /> in fact, factory-model shadowsuits routinely provided mass-produced goggles,<ref name="CW" /> while the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] included [[VidGraph/Legends|VidGraph]] [[Peer Macrobinoculars|Peer macrobinoculars]], known as "snooper goggles", with its standard-issue suits.<ref name="RO" />

The shadowsuit was made of [[Shadowsilk/Legends|shadowsilk]],<ref name="RO" /> a soft<ref name="AE" /> but tough<ref name="RO" /> special fiber<ref name="CW" /> that absorbed both light and sound. As such, the resulting suit improved the stealth of the wearer.<ref name="RO" /> The shadowsuit lacked any electronic device that could be detected by [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]],<ref name="AE" /> including [[Sensor scrambler/Legends|sensor scramblers]] and energy signature,<ref name="RO" /> relying entirely in its passive abilities.<ref name="AE" />

The shadowsuit also included [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] and slippers<ref name="RO" /> that featured additional sound-attenuating stuffing<ref name="AE" /> to reduce the noise a wearer made by moving and thus increasing that user's stealth.<ref name="CW" /> Including those cushions, the shadowsuit weighed a total of three [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]],<ref name="AE" /> or two kilograms in some cases.<ref name="SV" /> It was made from cloth that was thin enough to allow a second type of armor to be donned either over<ref name="CW" /> or under the shadowsuit.<ref name="AE" />

==History==
[[File:Lightscoutarmorandshadowsuit.png|thumb|left|A shadowsuit (right) in use.]]
[[Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles/Legends|Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles]] produced the shadowsuit, bringing it to the market at some point before [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] at a price of 600 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="AE" /> Not commonly found in prestigious stores of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], it was available to [[Soldier/Legends|military]] interests and found use among [[Scoundrel/Legends|thieves]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]].<ref name="SV" /> During the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], this item was legally restricted in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]],<ref name="LF">{{Wizards|url=DnD/rpga/downloads/LF_Hero_Gen.zip|text=''Living Force'' Hero Creation Guidelines}}</ref> but the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Shiana Trist]] used it there nonetheless.<ref name="AA">{{LivingForce|Contract AA23 (roleplaying adventure)}}</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the covert [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForces]] of the Alliance to Restore the Republic manufactured custom-made shadowsuits, hand-sewing these with the best available shadowsilk, shaking the shadowsuits to avoid rubbing noises, and including a muffled layer in gloves and slippers. The SpecForces had a limited number of units of the armor, even if they tried to keep up with their sizeable backlog. None of these individualized units were available for sale.<ref name="RO" />

==Behind the scenes==
The handcrafted shadowsuit of the Rebel Alliance was first mentioned in ''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]'' ([[1997]]), a [[Roleplaying game|role-playing]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' written by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]]. The book included the first image of a shadowsuit, drawn by [[Storn Cook]]. ''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]'' added information on the shadowsuit, connecting it with Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles for the first time.

''Arms & Equipment Guide'' and ''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]'' mention that a user can don a shadowsuit and second armor at the same time, but both mention that the game benefits of the shadowsuit are lost in such a case. The [[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'' sourcebook]] says that the shadowsuit weighs only two kilograms, while both the previous ''Arms & Equipment Guide'' and the later ''The Clone Wars Campaign Guide'' say that it weighs three kilograms; this article assumes that some units weighed two kilograms while others weighed three.
